git.subject: Keep evaluation records in Git and drop bulky outside-Git artifacts.
git.matchRule: HEAD must equal git.head, or git.head must be an ancestor of HEAD (git merge-base --is-ancestor <pin> HEAD). Working tree must be clean for a commit pin; otherwise write a source-snapshot/.
git.note: Clean commit includes pathMorph 0.3.0 and gradientStroke 0.4.0. Historical run 2026-10-07T194646Z still records its dirty-tree snapshot under source-snapshot/.

snapshot.how: If git status --short is non-empty, write docs/evaluations/<run-id>/source-snapshot/ with: the short status, git rev-parse HEAD (if any), and SHA-256 of every file under packages/, fixtures/import/, evaluation/harness/, and docs/languages/ that differs from HEAD or is untracked and included. Set manifest.implementation.snapshot to that directory. Do not claim a commit-only pin for a dirty tree. Do not commit working-tree.patch or full tree copies.

nextCause.versionDecision: New contract (not in published 0.4.0). Publish a new language version entry (expected 0.5.0) per docs/languages/compatibility-policy.md. Wire may stay "0.2" only if that version file says so and requiredCapabilities gates the feature; otherwise wire "0.3". Not a package-only bump.
